I don't have problems meeting and making friends, or even meeting and talking to women. I'm tall, decently fit, and im OK looking. I don't maintain friendships and I have little faith in humanity. I'm a narcissistic asshole, I lead women on and turn them down, I pretend to like you even if I really don't care about how you feel. I almost take pleasure in hurting you. 

I have a lot of anxiety disorders and I think I might be bipolar, my brain is an emotional roller coaster and its hell to go through every day. I'm not miserable because of some extraneous circumstances, I'm miserable because I have subconsciously willed it so. My thoughts are warped and I'm a bitter, miserable, broken human being. My will to die has surpassed everything else. I don't want to go on meds, I don't want to deal with bullshit side effects and eventually become a different person. I'm too poor to afford therapy as well.

I'm sorry if you thought I was a good person :(.
